summary: D1-D2 Pass D: campaign bump (c10->c11) + re-plan + generate dossiers/summaries
description: Pass D (docs/dossiers/) stream — the document-knowledge layer. UNIT IS THE WORK: the three books are singleton works (work_id == text_id), each gets its own dossier + summary tree. HARD DEP: D1 requires every member text through ingest node 07 (ticket 41526ce1). Node D1 (plan-freeze): adding works to the frozen corpus forces a CAMPAIGN BUMP — current is c10; this is c11. Use the campaign-bump contract; re-plan whole (never partial), prior works' span ids carry forward. PROVIDER DECIDED: llamacpp local (llama.cpp on the 3090) — this is itself a campaign parameter, consistent with c11 being a new campaign. In config/dossiers.toml set provider='llamacpp', PIN model explicitly (record verbatim in staged rows' model col — the c8 bench used Qwen3.8; confirm the current local model at run time), set input_budget 6000-8000 (activates folds + figures/terms map-reduce for works whose L1 set exceeds it). GPU: announce use + get per-run permission; 'llm stop' when done. Node D2 (generate) -> staged_summaries + staged_dossier_fields for the three works. DONE: span-plan-c11 frozen incl. the 3 works; staged rows generated under llamacpp with model pinned.
